chapterInfo.content:
9
Twam afahyɛdie ho asɛm
1Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose Sinai serɛ so, wɔn Misraim asase so fire afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu no bosome a ɛdi kan no mu sɛ: 2#Eks 12; Lew 23.5 Ma Israelfoɔ no nni twam no ne berɛ mu. 3Bosome yi da a ɛtɔ so dunan no anwummerɛ, monni no ne berɛ mu; sɛdeɛ n’ahyɛdeɛ ne n’akwan nyinaa so na monnie. 4Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ, wɔnni twam no. 5Na wɔdii twam no bosome a ɛdi kan no da a ɛtɔ so dunan no anwummerɛ, Sinai serɛ so; sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no nyinaa, saa na Israel mma no yɛeɛ.
6 # Num 19.11 Na mmarima bi wɔ hɔ a wɔn ho akum wɔ efunu bi ho, na wɔantumi anni twam no ɛda no; na wɔbaa Mose ne Aaron anim da no ara; 7na mmarima no see no sɛ: Yɛn deɛ, yɛn ho akum wɔ efunu bi ho; adɛn na wɔbɛkame yɛn sɛ yɛmmfa yɛn ayɛyɛdeɛ mmmrɛ AWURADE ne berɛ mu wɔ Israelfoɔ mu? 8Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monnyina hɔ na menkɔtie deɛ AWURADE bɛhyɛ ama mo. 9Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 10Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Sɛ mo anaa mo asefoɔ mu bi ho kum wɔ efunu bi ho anaasɛ ɔwɔ akwantuo mu akyirikyiri a, ɔnni twam mma AWURADE ara. 11Bosome a ɛtɔ so mmienu no da a ɛtɔ so dunan anwummerɛ na wɔnnie; apiti ne ɛfan nwononwono na wɔmfa nnie: 12Wɔnnnya bi nnkɔsi anɔpa na wɔmmmu ne dompe; wɔnni twam no ho ahyɛdeɛ no nyinaa so. 13Na deɛ ne ho teɛ na ɔntuu kwan na ɔpo twam no die no, wɔbɛtwa ɔkra no afiri ne man mu atwene, ɛfiri sɛ wamfa AWURADE ayɛyɛdeɛ no amma ne berɛ mu; saa onipa no nsoa ne bɔne. 14Na sɛ ɔhɔhoɔ bi bɛsoɛ mo mu a, ɔnni twam mma AWURADE: Twam ahyɛdeɛ ne ne yɛbea no so na ɔnnie, ɔhɔhoɔ oo, asase no soni oo, ahyɛdeɛ baako na ɛnna hɔ mma mo.
Ogya ne mununkum fadum no
15 # Eks 40.34-38 Na ɛda a wɔmaa tenabea no so sii hɔ no, mununkum no bɛkataa adanseɛ ntomadan no tenabea no so, na anwummerɛ, wɔhwɛ a, na ɛredɛre sɛ ogya wɔ tenabea no so de kɔsi anɔpa. 16Saa na na ɛyɛ daa, mununkum no kata so awia na ogya no pue anadwo. 17Na sɛ mununkum no ma ne ho so firi ntomadan no so a, na Israelfoɔ no tuo; na deɛ mununkum no gyina no, ɛhɔ na Israelfoɔ no kyere nsraban. 18AWURADE anomu asɛm so na Israelfoɔ no nam tuo, na AWURADE anomu asɛm so na wɔnam kyere nsraban; nna a mununkum no tena tenabea no soɔ nyinaa no, wɔtena nsram. 19Na sɛ mununkum no di tenabea no so nna pii mpo a, Israelfoɔ no yɛ AWURADE ahyɛdeɛ, na wɔntu. 20Na sɛ ebia mununkum no tena tenabea no so nna kakraa bi a, AWURADE anomu asɛm so na wɔnam kyere nsraban, na AWURADE anomu asɛm so na wɔnam tuo. 21Na sɛ ebia mununkum no gyina firi anwummerɛ kɔsi anɔpa na ɛma ne ho so anɔpa a, wɔtu; na sɛ awia ne anadwo na mununkum no ma ne ho so a, wɔtu; 22na sɛ nnanu, sɛ bosome, sɛ nna bebree, na mununkum no di tenabea no so a na ɛsi so ara a, Israelfoɔ no tena nsram na wɔntu; na sɛ ɛma ne ho so a, na wɔtuo. 23AWURADE anomu asɛm so na wɔnam kyere nsraban, na AWURADE anomu asɛm so na wɔnam tuo. AWURADE ahyɛdeɛ na wɔyɛeɛ, sɛdeɛ AWURADE nam Mose so hyɛeɛ no.

Na wɔdii twam no bosome a ɛdi kan no da a ɛtɔ so dunan no anwummerɛ, Sinai serɛ so; sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no nyinaa, saa na Israel mma no yɛeɛ.

Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monnyina hɔ na menkɔtie deɛ AWURADE bɛhyɛ ama mo. Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Sɛ mo anaa mo asefoɔ mu bi ho kum wɔ efunu bi ho anaasɛ ɔwɔ akwantuo mu akyirikyiri a, ɔnni twam mma AWURADE ara. Na sɛ ɔhɔhoɔ bi bɛsoɛ mo mu a, ɔnni twam mma AWURADE: Twam ahyɛdeɛ ne ne yɛbea no so na ɔnnie, ɔhɔhoɔ oo, asase no soni oo, ahyɛdeɛ baako na ɛnna hɔ mma mo.

Na ɛda a wɔmaa tenabea no so sii hɔ no, mununkum no bɛkataa adanseɛ ntomadan no tenabea no so, na anwummerɛ, wɔhwɛ a, na ɛredɛre sɛ ogya wɔ tenabea no so de kɔsi anɔpa. Saa na na ɛyɛ daa, mununkum no kata so awia na ogya no pue anadwo. Na sɛ mununkum no ma ne ho so firi ntomadan no so a, na Israelfoɔ no tuo; na deɛ mununkum no gyina no, ɛhɔ na Israelfoɔ no kyere nsraban. AWURADE anomu asɛm so na Israelfoɔ no nam tuo, na AWURADE anomu asɛm so na wɔnam kyere nsraban; nna a mununkum no tena tenabea no soɔ nyinaa no, wɔtena nsram. Na sɛ mununkum no di tenabea no so nna pii mpo a, Israelfoɔ no yɛ AWURADE ahyɛdeɛ, na wɔntu. Na sɛ ebia mununkum no tena tenabea no so nna kakraa bi a, AWURADE anomu asɛm so na wɔnam kyere nsraban, na AWURADE anomu asɛm so na wɔnam tuo. app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
